best_idea: Redraw only when the state says something can change (and at least every 100 ms), clamp any gap to 100 ms, and carry the leftover milliseconds so timers never drift.
decision_why: The delta clamp, the capped redraw skip and the remainder-carrying timer fit a browser loop; the sleep-to-target governor is redundant with requestAnimationFrame, and the donor's skip gate covers only a walking hero, so the live duel must never skip (the fight is the whole fight).
acceptance: A duel never skips a drawn frame (a client test asserts the redraw gate is open in every duel state); an idle screen redraws at most every 100 ms, and no single frame advances timers by more than 100 ms.
